title: Alive time or dead time?
coreMove: Convert waiting, loss, or constraint into usable work before resentment converts it into dead time.
sourcePressure: Failure section: active use of setback versus passive suffering. Supported by frozen TOC and book skeleton; no per-chapter source sidecar exists in the latest run.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Making every setback positive instead of distinguishing active use from passive decay.
sourceAnchorNote: No named person, study, place, or artifact is available in the frozen source sidecar for this chapter; use fictional scenarios only and do not invent source anecdotes.

exampleOpeningDiversity.rule: no more than 2 of the 6 examples may open with the pattern 'At HH:MM, <Name> <verb>s'
